note: The built core combines this repository's integration with Flycast and is distributed under the GPL-2.0-or-later. The software rasteriser is skmp's refsw from libswirl, BSD-3-Clause, which the GPL permits; libchdr, zlib, zstd and lzma are permissive likewise.

components.name: chimera-core-flycast (integration)
components.license: MIT, and Flycast's terms for patches/

components.name: libchdr (with zlib, zstd and lzma)
components.license: BSD-3-Clause, zlib, BSD-3-Clause and public domain respectively

components.name: glslang
components.license: BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, MIT and Apache-2.0, with its generated parser under GPL-3.0 with the Bison exception
components.note: A submodule of Flycast. The compiler that turns the GLSL Flycast writes for its Vulkan renderer into SPIR-V: the front end and the SPIR-V writer, without the optimiser and without HLSL. Used only when the Renderer setting is vulkan-hw.

components.name: Vulkan Memory Allocator
components.note: A submodule of Flycast. Used only when the Renderer setting is vulkan-hw.

components.name: Vulkan-Headers
components.note: A submodule of Flycast: the Khronos headers and C++ bindings its Vulkan renderer is compiled against.

components.name: libretro-common (one header, libretro_vulkan.h)
components.note: The interface Flycast's windowless Vulkan context is handed its device through. Its licence is the comment at its top.
